column1: sentence
Usual Frame: Another problem! Why me??? Reframe: Ooh, a new puzzle to solve.
Usual Frame: Art is entertainment. Reframe: Art is a powerful, mind-altering drug.
Usual Frame: Death is a tragedy, and I need to feel bad about it. Reframe: The deceased has no more problems. How did I make this about me?
Usual Frame: Giving compliments is awkward, creepy, or manipulative. Reframe: Withholding a compliment is almost immoral.
Usual Frame: I am waiting in line, which is a waste of time. Reframe: I have time to breathe properly.
Usual Frame: I want food, so I must be hungry. Reframe: I want food, so I might be tired.
Usual Frame: I'm hungry, so I need food. Reframe: I'm hungry, so I need protein.
Usual Frame: I'm talking to you, teen, and this is between us. Reframe: I must answer to your future self, not your current self.
Usual Frame: Learn what you need. Reframe: Learn continuously, especially skills that work well together.
Usual Frame: Measure twice, cut once. Reframe: Just start. See if you can figure it out as you go.
Usual Frame: Most people are normal, but I'm a basket case. Reframe: Everyone is a basket case once you get to know them.
Usual Frame: My mind is in my brain. Reframe: My mind includes my brain, body, and physical environment. Any change to one changes the others.
Usual Frame: One of us is right, and one is wrong. Reframe: We are watching two different movies on one screen.
Usual Frame: People come up with their own opinions. Reframe: People join teams, and the media assigns their opinions.
Usual Frame: People judge me, so I feel bad when I mess up. Reframe: People only care about themselves. They don't care what dumb thing I did recently, even if they mention it.
Usual Frame: People treat you poorly, and you can't do much about it. Reframe: You cause people to act the way they do.

Usual Frame: People with bad judgment often pursue dangerous and unproductive pleasures. Reframe: People need a minimum level of pleasure to make life worth living, and if they can't get it safely, they will get it unsafely.
Usual Frame: Praise for your creation predicts you have a hit. Reframe: Only action predicts a hit, not words. Watch for people to extend or modify your creation.
Usual Frame: Some art is good, and some is bad. Reframe: If there is a market for the art, it is good art.
Usual Frame: Some people are good, and some are not. Reframe: We're all flawed, and we're all good at different things.
Usual Frame: Ugh, I hate this repetitive chore. Reframe: I can do this chore so gracefully and efficiently it feels like a game.
Usual Frame: Whatever managers do is managing. Reframe: If you are not measuring, you are not managing.
Usual Frame: When I am hungry, I eat food. Reframe: Some food is fuel. Some food is entertainment.
Usual Frame: You are the center of your universe and the highest priority. Reframe: Viewed from space, everything looks small, including your problems.
Usual Frame: Your ego is 'you,' and it must be protected. Reframe: Your ego is your enemy.
Usual Frame: Alcohol is a beverage. Reframe: Alcohol is poison.
Usual Frame: Compete against yourself and try to improve over time. Reframe: Compete against others even if the others are unaware of the competition.
Usual Frame: Confidence is something you're born with. Reframe: Confidence is something you learn.
Usual Frame: Criticism feels like a dagger to your heart. Reframe: Criticism is a chemical reaction in the skull of someone who isn't in the room.
Usual Frame: Death is a tragedy. Reframe: It is an honor to help another pass.
Usual Frame: Fairness is a desirable social goal. Reframe: Fairness is the enemy of success.
Usual Frame: Find yourself. Reframe: Author yourself.
Usual Frame: Germs will harm me. Reframe: Germs make me stronger.
Usual Frame: Hate and anger are toxic feelings you hope will wear off. Reframe: Hate and anger are a superpower level of energy you can use for gain.
Usual Frame: I am angry because something happened. Reframe: I am living in the past.
Usual Frame: I am anxious. Reframe: I am living in the future (but not in a good way).
Usual Frame: I am my inner thoughts. Reframe: I am what I do.
Usual Frame: I am tempted by bad carbs. Reframe: I'm not the kind of person who eats bad carbs.
Usual Frame: I can discern people's motives by their actions. Reframe: Mind-reading isn't real. Humans are terrible at discerning motives.
Usual Frame: I can't get to sleep. Reframe: I didn't work hard enough.
Usual Frame: I can't handle this for the rest of my life. Reframe: I can do anything for a day.
Usual Frame: I can't think of anything good to write. Reframe 3: I can write something bad and fix it.
Usual Frame: I can't think of anything to write. Reframe 1: I'm in the wrong environment for writing.
Usual Frame: I fail at 90 percent of the things I try. Reframe: I only need to succeed 10 percent of the time.
Usual Frame: I feel a responsibility to hold this guilt. Reframe: You have my permission to release your guilt.
Usual Frame: I feel bad that I was the lone survivor. Reframe: What would the dead want you to do - suffer or be happy?
Usual Frame: I hate someone who deserves it. Reframe: Hate is nothing but punishing myself for the misdeeds of others.
Usual Frame: I have lost my soulmate. Reframe: I have a million soulmates I have not yet met.
Usual Frame: I have writer's block. Reframe 2: I'm trying to write at the wrong time of day.
Usual Frame: I want my relationship to last forever. Reframe: Nothing lasts forever.
Usual Frame: I want to do (something). Reframe: I have decided to do (something).
Usual Frame: I worry something will go wrong. Reframe: I'm curious what will happen.
Usual Frame: Is this a good decision? Reframe: Can we test it small?
Usual Frame: It takes money to make money. Reframe: I can turn energy into money.
Usual Frame: Judge people by their mistakes. Reframe: Judge people by how they respond to their mistakes.
Usual Frame: Luck is random and can't be managed. Reframe: You can go where there is more luck (more energy).
Usual Frame: Manage your time. Reframe: Manage your energy.
Usual Frame: My feelings are the result of my situation. Reframe: How I feel is my choice.
Usual Frame: My stomach has room for more food. Reframe: I've had enough.
Usual Frame: Nuclear Power is risky. Reframe: Nuclear power is green.
Usual Frame: Passion is the key to success. Reframe: Passion is nice but not required.
Usual Frame: People are rational 90 percent of the time. Reframe: People are rational 10 percent of the time if that.
Usual Frame: Stress comes with the job. Reframe: Reducing stress IS your job.
Usual Frame: Success depends on who you know. Reframe: Success depends on how many people you know.
Usual Frame: Sugar is delicious but don't overdo it. Reframe: Sugar is poison.
Usual Frame: Taking the dog for a walk and failing. Reframe: Taking the dog for a sniff and succeeding.
Usual Frame: The boss is in charge. Reframe: The most capable people are in charge.
Usual Frame: The universe is acting against me. Reframe: The universe owes me.
Usual Frame: The usual patterns hold (non-humor). Reframe: The usual patterns are violated (humor).
Usual Frame: Things should be fair. (me) Reframe: Life isn't fair. (Mom)
Usual Frame: Why did I survive when others did not? Reframe: It's no different from a clock reading 2:00 PM exactly once a day. It is just cause and effect. It has no meaning.
Usual Frame: Why me? Reframe: God needs you here for something important.
Usual Frame: You could have done more. Reframe: Everyone can do more. It is a meaningless concept.
Usual Frame: You feel like a fraud. Everyone else is competent. Reframe: You are learning fast. Look at all you learned!
Usual Frame: Your critics are evil monsters. Reframe: Your critics are your mascots.
Usual frame: You did this wrong. Reframe: Your other work is stronger.
